description: Java source file defining an abstract class 'MonkeyEvent' for representing and injecting different types of events in Android's Monkey testing framework. The class includes event type constants, methods for getting event type, checking if it is throttlable, and an abstract method for event injection.

classes.name: MonkeyEvent
classes.description: Abstract class representing a generic event in Android's Monkey testing tool, with event type constants and an abstract method for injecting events.

methods.name: MonkeyEvent(int type)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with a specified type.

methods.name: isThrottlable
methods.description: Indicates whether it is safe to throttle after this event; default implementation returns true.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to inject the event using provided window and activity managers, returning a status code.
